What this supports

An official copyright application list records a named Pinnacle artwork application. Company publications identify a wider intellectual-property and publishing portfolio.

Scope & limits

An application listing is not a granted registration. Brand usage, ISBNs and book publication do not establish device efficacy or patent rights.

Build the full title-by-title ledger from issued trademark/copyright records and ISBN notices before asserting the entire estate is registered.
